name: Musix Analysis
author: Musix
description: For the Musix app: measures each song's loudness and how it starts and ends (levelling and SmoothFade), and finds similar albums and artists from AudioMuse-AI's sound analysis.

versions.changelog: Measure all songs at once (with a warning), shorter rounds so AudioMuse can start its own jobs, and reloading the settings page no longer starts a job again.
First version: volume and fade profiles, similar albums and artists, each with its own progress.
